Funerary activities associated with the death of the father of Dennett's cook: 'the elder addresses the prince and his people, and
the strangers who have come to hear how the deceased has died, and offers them each a drink'.
Men standing outside a hut. The context of the photograph is the funeral of the father of one of Dennett's cooks.

Looking towards the home of a deceased man, the father of Dennett's cook, with a coffin under the porchway painted in crossed white lines and with a small cross. Memorabilia are placed on top. To the right, visitors arrive.

Funerary activities associated with the death of the father of Dennett's cook: 'When all are assembled, the elder addresses the two
family fetishes held by two of the family ... and when he has finished his address, the two who hold the fetishes, or wooden figures, pick up a little earth and throw it on the heads of the fetishes, then, lifting them up, rub their heads in the earth in front of them.'
Man standing on the path leading to a homestead. The context of the photograph is the funeral of the father of one of Dennett's cooks.
